status: review-only V6 frozen-axis socket and front/top portal candidate; not a production print, tube-cut, or drilling release

portal.construction: blind internal square sockets and broad face pads truly unioned into the V5 upper shells

acceptance_holds: The V6 sockets must use the frozen V0.3 lower targets, accepted axes, head-X-projected roll, 20.5 mm opening, 30 mm insertion depth, and M4 cross-bolt location without local re-aiming.
Both portal pads and sockets must be true unions with their upper shells; append-only overlapping components are prohibited.
Every modified shell and the socket coupon must remain one closed manifold component.
No portal pad, socket wall, or hardware feature may protrude beyond the approved faceted exterior.
A seated 19 mm rail and the sampled straight withdrawal/insertion path must clear the complete printed shell set when the rear bezel is removed for service.
The seated rails must clear the installed rear bezel and bottom keel.
The M4 bolt body, head, washer, nut, and straight tool-approach envelopes must have usable internal access without an exterior shell hole.
The 19 mm tube and 20.5 mm socket coupon must be printed in the intended ASA process and physically accepted before upper-shell production printing or rail drilling.
Final rail cut length, lower shoes, anti-crush plugs, backplate perimeter holes, lamp envelope, ears, eyes, glow-panel mounts, and remaining shell seams stay blocked.
